title: SYSK’s Scare Your Socks Off Halloween Spooktacular 2019
summary: Halloween special in which Josh Clark and Chuck Bryant read Philip K. Dick's public-domain short story "The Hanging Stranger" and then discuss it. Opening banter notes the ad-free Halloween tradition and a content warning for graphic violence. The story follows Ed Lewis, a TV store owner in Pikeville, who finds a hanging body in the town square, discovers the town has been taken over by winged insect aliens from a rift in the sky, flees, kills a possessed man and his own possessed son, and is revealed to be bait in a trap. The hosts close with a brief discussion of the story's ending and sign off.

entities.name: Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep

segments.title: Halloween intro and ad-free tradition
segments.summary: Josh gives a content warning about graphic violence, welcomes listeners, and explains the show keeps Halloween and Christmas episodes ad-free. He introduces Philip K. Dick and confirms the story is public domain.

segments.title: Reading: The Hanging Stranger, part one
segments.summary: Hosts read the opening of the story. Ed Lewis drives past a body hanging from a lamp post in the town square of Pikeville. Nobody else reacts, and the police arrive. Lewis is taken to the police car and escapes after realizing the town seems to be under some kind of control.

segments.title: Reading: winged insects at City Hall and the bus
segments.summary: Lewis flees into an alley and sees winged insect-like shapes landing on City Hall from a dark rift in the sky. He boards a bus, sees people he believes are possessed, and jumps off after a man with a book watches him. He kills that man with a rock.

segments.title: Reading: home, family, and the insect son
segments.summary: Lewis takes his wife Janet and sons home, plans to flee to Oak Grove by an abandoned back road, and kills his possessed son Jimmy, who has become a winged insect, with a butcher knife. He then leaves his family and flees on foot.

segments.title: Reading: the ending and the bait twist
segments.summary: Lewis reaches Oak Grove, tells a commissioner his story, and is told the hanging body was bait to draw out people who had escaped control. The story closes with a bank vice president walking past another hanging figure on a telephone pole.

segments.title: Post-story discussion and Halloween wrap-up
segments.summary: Hosts discuss whether Lewis was insane, the chain of victims, and whether the story would make a good short film. They wrap up with Halloween wishes and sign off.

segments.title: Sign-off
segments.summary: Josh and Chuck wish listeners a happy Halloween and close the episode with the standard show credit.
